posts.title: Why Notes Apps Fail ADHD Brains (And How to Brain Dump Without Overwhelm)
posts.excerpt: Most notes apps force you to decide too early. Here is why capturing and organizing at the same time exhausts ADHD working memory—and the 3 simple rules to brain dump without overwhelm.

author.name: Pavan Duggirala
author.bio: Product strategist living with ADHD, exploring calm, zero-friction externalization systems.
